<topicMap
    xmlns="http://www.topicmaps.org/xtm/"
    version="2.0">

  <association>
    <type>
      <topicRef href="#assoctype"/>
    </type>
    <role reifier="#reifier1">  <!-- role 1 -->
      <type>
        <topicRef href="#roletype1"/>
      </type>
      <topicRef href="#player1"/>
    </role>
  </association>

  <association>
    <type>
      <topicRef href="#assoctype2"/>
    </type>
    <role reifier="#reifier1">  <!-- Same signature as role 1 and same reifier as role 1 but the parent is not equal: BOOOM!!! -->
      <type>
        <topicRef href="#roletype1"/>
      </type>
      <topicRef href="#player1"/>
    </role>
  </association>

</topicMap>
